incorrectExamples: What the project now needs are a permanent funding arrangement
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 前面的 imagine... 引出一個情境，後面的完整分句說明該情境造成的結果，因此可用冒號。若保留逗號，會把兩個獨立結構錯誤連接。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 前後是兩個完整主句，而且後句是前句的結果，因此加入 so。也可用分號，但分號不會明確標示因果關係。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 前後都是完整主句，不能只用逗號連接。加入 and 後，兩個主句形成正確的並列結構。分號或句號也是可接受替代。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: the final guest had already left 和 the coordinator still had three forms to check 都是完整主句，不能只用逗號連接。可用分號、句號，或加入 and／but 等連接詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: school uniforms can... 和 they can cause... 都是完整主句，由 but 連接時，正式寫作通常在 but 前加逗號。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：PUNCT HOWEVER COMMA LOWERCASE_IF
rules.explanationZhHant: However 是句首連接副詞，後面加逗號。if 仍在同一句內，因此使用小寫。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: Therefore 在句首作連接副詞，正式寫作中通常以逗號與主句分隔。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: Nowadays 位於句首作時間副詞，正式寫作中通常在後面加逗號。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: As a result 是句首連接語，後面通常加逗號。後面的 but mentally still... 是省略了重複主語和助動詞的平行結構，本身可以成立。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: after work 位於主句前作時間狀語，加入逗號可清楚標示主句從 people 開始。短狀語的逗號有時可省略，但本句結構複雜，應保留。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: in Italy 用來說明是哪一個國家的較年長組別，是必要的限定資料，不應用兩個逗號把它當作可刪除的插入語。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 完整陳述句結束時需要句號。段落換行本身不能取代句末標點。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: a few 表示「有一些」，帶正面存在意思；few 表示「幾乎沒有」。根據本句要指出已有一些優秀作品，使用 a few。兩者都合文法，但意思不同。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: time 在此是不可數名詞，所以使用 a little， 不用修飾複數可數名詞的 a few。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: a little 修飾不可數名詞，表示仍有少量可用。a little extra time 與前面的 little time 形成有意義的對照。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: funding 是不可數名詞，要用 little／ a little， 不用 few。原意是雖然資金不多，但仍有一些，因此選擇較正面的 a little。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 後半句要表達能清楚解釋證據的人很少，因此用 few。若作者只是中性地說有幾人做到，a few 也正確。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: a great deal of 修飾不可數名詞； applications 是複數可數名詞，所以用 a large number of。對照： a great deal of interest。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示不可數名詞數量較少，用 less time。 lesser 通常表示地位、程度或重要性較低，如 a lesser offence。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: little 直接修飾不可數名詞： little time。只有在 little of the time 這種帶限定詞的結構中才使用 of。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: time 在這裡是不可數名詞，所以不用 few。 little time 表示剩餘時間很少。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示數量超過一個，固定結構是 more than one + 單數可數名詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: Why the evening bus does stop
rules.correctPattern: Why does the evening bus stop
rules.explanationZhHant: 直接疑問句使用疑問詞 + 助動詞 + 主語 + 動詞原形。 does 已承擔第三身單數標記，所以主要動詞用 stop。
correctExamples: Why does the evening bus stop
incorrectExamples: Why the evening bus does stop
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：QUESTION DIRECT WH_OBJECT DO_SUPPORT
rules.explanationZhHant: 這是直接問句， why 問原因而不是主語，所以一般過去式需要 did 倒裝；加入 did 後，主要動詞回到原形 reject。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: does 已承擔第三身單數和現在時標記，後面的主要動詞使用原形 have。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: The app is working now, is it?
rules.correctPattern: The app is working now, isn't it?
rules.explanationZhHant: 中性的確認問句通常由肯定主句配合否定附加問句： isn't it?。同極性的 is it? 可在驚訝、質疑或挑戰語氣中成立，因此不應忽略語調和語境。
correctExamples: The app is working now, isn't it?
incorrectExamples: The app is working now, is it?
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: how many candidates 本身是 completed 的主語。主語疑問句通常不使用 do／ does／ did。對照：How many forms did the candidates complete? 中，疑問詞問賓語，所以需要 did。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 前面有 scanner 和 laptop 兩個可能的單數先行詞，it 指涉不安全。系統只有在原意已記錄為 laptop 時才可明確改寫；否則應要求補充資料。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：REFERENCE CHAIN MULTIPLE_IT ABSTAIN
rules.incorrectPattern: because it was unrealistic, although it had drafted it
rules.correctPattern: because the timetable was unrealistic, although the committee itself had drafted it
rules.explanationZhHant: 三個 it 可能分別指 committee 或 timetable，單靠句子不能安全確定。目標句依據已記錄原意解開指涉；沒有原意資料時，預期行動應是 abstention。
correctExamples: because the timetable was unrealistic, although the committee itself had drafted it
incorrectExamples: because it was unrealistic, although it had drafted it
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 在剛提到的兩個群體中指第二個，可用 the latter。the last 通常指一個序列中最後的一項，不一定只是兩者中的第二者。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: blue 是形容詞；若省略複數名詞 folders，要用代名詞 ones 承接：the blue ones。 the rich 等指人群的名詞化形容詞是另一類結構。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 省略已出現的單數可數名詞 route 時，用 one 承接：the blue one。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 系統故障發生在她說話之前，因此使用過去完成式，清楚顯示兩個過去事件的先後次序。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 主句使用過去式 said，而收取申請發生在說話之前，因此可回移為過去完成式 had received。如果內容仍屬當前有效事實，有時可以不回移。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 間接引述從較後的時間回顧說話內容時， last evening 常改為 the previous evening。若敘述時間仍與原說話時間相同，則不一定需要改。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 從過去敘述點描述其後發生的事情，可把 will 回移為 would。 如果九時的工作坊在報告當刻仍屬未來，保留 will 也可能合理。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：REPORTING ASK WHETHER NO_THAT
rules.explanationZhHant: ask 後面的間接是非問句直接由 whether 或 if 引出，不同時使用 that。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: deny 表示否認做過某事時，後面接動名詞： deny doing。 也可接 that 分句，例如 denied that she had shared the files。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: promised each applicant to contact them
rules.explanationZhHant: 做出承諾的人也是執行聯絡的人，因此用 promise to + 動詞。 promise someone to do 不能表示說話者承諾自己做事。也可寫 promised each applicant that she would contact them。
incorrectExamples: promised each applicant to contact them
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: tell 可直接接聽者： tell someone that...。say 若要加入聽者，通常寫 say to someone that...。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：REPORTING WARN NP NOT_TO_INFINITIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示警告某人不要做某事，用 warn + 人 + not to + 動詞原形。 另一個正確結構是 warn someone against doing something。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示自己也不具備前述情況，用 Neither + 助動詞 + 主語。對照肯定回應：So do I.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 正確拼法是 employees。這是拼字問題，不是句法規則。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示比例較大，要寫 larger。lager 是一種啤酒，屬於另一個真實英文詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 正確拼法是 resolve。這是拼字問題，不是句法規則。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 正確拼法是 retail。這是拼字問題，不是句法規則。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 正確拼法是 winter。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: a number of + 複數名詞表示若干個，意思接近 several， 因此使用複數動詞。不要與 the number of 混淆。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 正式學術語境可把 data 視為 datum 的複數，因此用 were。 現代一般英文亦常把 data 當集合或不可數名詞並配合 was，不可一律拒絕。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: Either the interns or the archivist are
rules.correctPattern: Either the interns or the archivist is
rules.explanationZhHant: 在 either A or B 結構中，動詞通常配合較接近它的主語。最近的是單數 archivist，所以用 is。為避免不自然，也可改寫為 Either the archivist or the interns are...。
correctExamples: Either the interns or the archivist is
incorrectExamples: Either the interns or the archivist are
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA EXISTENTIAL THERE SINGULAR_HEAD IS
rules.explanationZhHant: 存現句的動詞要配合後面的真正主語。a loss 是單數，因此使用 there is，不用 there are。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA FRACTION PLURAL_HEAD PLURAL
rules.explanationZhHant: volunteers 是複數，因此 half of the volunteers 配合複數動詞 were。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA FRACTION UNCOUNTABLE_HEAD SINGULAR
rules.explanationZhHant: 分數結構的動詞配合 of 後面的名詞。 equipment 是不可數單數，所以用 was。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA MEASURE DISTANCE SINGULAR
rules.explanationZhHant: 一段距離被視為一個整體量度時，使用單數動詞。比較： Ten kilometres of roads were repaired 中，主語是複數道路。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA MEASURE MONEY_AMOUNT SINGULAR
rules.explanationZhHant: 一筆金額被視為一個整體數量時，用單數動詞 was。若指多枚實體硬幣，複數動詞才可能合適。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 固定結構 more than one 後面使用單數可數名詞，並通常配合單數動詞：more than one volunteer was...。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: news 雖然以 s 結尾，但在標準英文中是不可數單數名詞，因此配合 was。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: one of those assistants who works
rules.correctPattern: one of those assistants who work
rules.explanationZhHant: 關係代名詞 who 的先行詞是複數 those assistants，所以關係分句用 work。Lena 是這群會留至很晚工作的助理之一。
correctExamples: one of those assistants who work
incorrectExamples: one of those assistants who works
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PAST PLURAL_SUBJECT WERE
rules.explanationZhHant: 關係分句的主語是複數 books， 所以 be 的過去式用 were。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PAST SINGULAR_SUBJECT WAS
rules.explanationZhHant: fridge 單數主語，be 的過去式用 was，所以寫 our fridge was。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 動詞與中心名詞 address 配合，而不是與所有格限定詞 their 配合。每名參與者有一個地址，因此用單數 was。單數 they／ their 不要求後面的名詞和動詞變成複數。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PRESENT COMPOUND_SUBJECT ARE
rules.incorrectPattern: work stress and financial pressure is
rules.correctPattern: work stress and financial pressure are
rules.explanationZhHant: work stress 和 financial pressure 由 and 連接，形成複合複數主語，所以使用 are。若兩個名詞被視為同一個不可分概念，單數才偶爾可能成立。
correctExamples: work stress and financial pressure are
incorrectExamples: work stress and financial pressure is
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PRESENT NEITHER_SINGULAR S_FORM
rules.explanationZhHant: neither route 按單數主語處理，所以一般現在式動詞用 includes。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PRESENT SINGULAR_GOVERNMENT S_FORM
rules.explanationZhHant: the government 在本句視為單數機構，一般現在式動詞用 sets。英式英文有時可把集體名詞視為複數，但本句聚焦政府作為一個政策制定者。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PRESENT SINGULAR_HEAD OF_PHRASE
rules.explanationZhHant: 真正的主語中心詞是單數 list；of places 只是修飾語，所以寫 The list… is。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA PRESENT UNCOUNTABLE_SUBJECT SINGULAR_BE
rules.explanationZhHant: equipment 是不可數名詞，按單數處理，所以寫 The equipment is。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：SVA RELATIVE SINGULAR_ANTECEDENT S_FORM
rules.explanationZhHant: who 指回單數 coordinator，因此一般現在式用第三身單數 knows。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: the number of... 的中心詞是單數 number，所以用單數動詞 was。後面的複數 rejections 不控制動詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: , together with two interns, have prepared
rules.correctPattern: , together with two interns, has prepared
rules.explanationZhHant: together with two interns 是附加資料，不會把主語變成複數。真正的中心主語是單數 coordinator，所以用 has。
correctExamples: , together with two interns, has prepared
incorrectExamples: , together with two interns, have prepared
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：TENSE BEFORE FUTURE_EVENT PRESENT_SIMPLE
rules.explanationZhHant: 本句談論尚未來臨的雨季。before 引出的未來時間分句通常用一般現在式，不用過去式。若整段談論過去事件， began 才可能正確。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 主語 age group 是單數，因此原本至少要寫 keeps； 但本句同時描述 2050 年的預測，正式圖表寫作更適合使用 is expected to remain。keeps being 在某些一般語境中可以成立，但不適合這個預測框架。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: By next June 表示在未來期限之前完成接管，所以使用未來完成式：will have + 過去分詞。若意思是「正正在六月接管」，簡單將來式才可能合適。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 這段描述一般校園情況，而不是一次已完成的過去事件，因此使用一般現在式 dress。 若整段是在敘述過去某一天， dressed 才可能適合。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: if 後面需要一個完整有限分句。主語是 the staff， 所以使用一般現在式 wear。 單獨的 wearing 不能作這個條件分句的謂語。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：TENSE MAP COMPLETED_PERIOD PAST_SIMPLE
rules.explanationZhHant: 1995 至 2025 是已完成的歷史時段，因此用一般過去式描述已發生的改變。若其中一幅圖表示現在，而改變延續至今，現在完成式才可能成立。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：TENSE PAST DATA_YEAR WAS
rules.explanationZhHant: 句子明確描述 2000 年的情況，因此使用過去式 was。後面的 2050 年預測則使用將來或預測結構。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：TENSE PAST_PERFECT BY_THE_TIME EARLIER_EVENT
rules.explanationZhHant: 關門和最後一位訪客離開都是過去事件，而訪客離開發生得更早，所以用過去完成式 had left。公式：較早的過去事件用 had + 過去分詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 過去完成式通常需要另一個較後的過去參考點。本句只是按時間順序描述圖表數據，因此使用一般過去式。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: in September 2023 是已完成的明確過去時間，一般使用過去式 began， 不用現在完成式。公式：明確過去時間 + 過去式。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 工作發展至今已成為生活的一部分，因此目標句使用現在完成式 has become。 work 是單數不可數主語，所以不能直接接 become。 若原意是一般規律，work becomes 也可成立，故應保留為可接受替代。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: damage 是被造成的，所以現在完成式要使用被動結構： has been + 過去分詞。主動句需要有施事者，例如 The delay has done serious damage.
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: For the past three months 表示活動由過去持續至現在，並強調過程，因此使用現在完成進行式。若工作已經全部完成，其他時態才可能成立。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: Since the trial began, the college collected
rules.correctPattern: Since the trial began, the college has collected
rules.explanationZhHant: since + 過去起點通常與現在完成式配合，表示由試行開始至現在所累積的結果。
correctExamples: Since the trial began, the college has collected
incorrectExamples: Since the trial began, the college collected
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.correctPattern: Since then, the scheme has attracted
rules.explanationZhHant: Since then 表示由過去某點延續至現在，通常使用現在完成式：has attracted。若敘述的參考時間也在過去，過去完成式可能更合適。
correctExamples: Since then, the scheme has attracted
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.correctPattern: is expected to become more pronounced
rules.explanationZhHant: diversify 通常表示種類變得更多，不適合直接描述兩國差異擴大。 2050 年亦是預測數據，因此使用 is expected to + 動詞原形。若原意只是差異持續存在，也可寫 is expected to continue。
correctExamples: is expected to become more pronounced
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 42.3% 是 2050 年的預測值，因此不能使用表示已完成過去事件的 doubled。使用 is projected to + 動詞原形表達預測。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.correctPattern: is projected to remain relatively stable
rules.explanationZhHant: has 後面本應使用過去分詞 remained，但本句包含 2050 年預測，因此現在完成式亦不合適。目標句使用 is projected to remain。 relatively stable 也容許比例有輕微變化。
correctExamples: is projected to remain relatively stable
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：TENSE UNTIL PRESENT_PERFECT NOT_WILL
rules.explanationZhHant: until 引出的未來時間分句一般不用 will。現在完成式強調所有建議先完成： until… have been implemented。另一個正確寫法是 until all recommendations are implemented。間接問句則可以用 will，例如 We do not know when they will be implemented。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：TIME CHART TWO_SNAPSHOTS IN_BOTH_YEARS
rules.explanationZhHant: 圖表只提供 2000 和 2050 兩個時間點時， in both 2000 and 2050 不會暗示中間每一年都有數據。若圖表真的展示連續趨勢， from 2000 to 2050 可以保留。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 兩個百分比之間的絕對差使用 percentage points。 由 45% 降至 20% 是下降 25 percentage points。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: per cent 在數字後不加複數 s：one per cent、50 percent。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB AFFORD DIRECT_OBJECT NO_FOR
rules.explanationZhHant: afford 作動詞時直接接所能負擔的事物，不加 for。對照：pay for private care 使用 for，因為動詞是 pay。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: agree 接完整內容分句時，用 agree that + 主語 + 動詞。agree with 通常接人、意見或名詞詞組，例如 agree with the proposal；不能在 with 後直接接 preventing illness is... 這類完整分句。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB ALLOW NP TO_INFINITIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: allow + 人 + to + 動詞原形，所以寫 allowed customers to compare。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示為某個行為道歉，用 apologise for + 名詞／動名詞。 about 可用於談論道歉的主題，但不是這個標準框架。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 人道歉，用 apologise to + 人。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB ASK NP TO_INFINITIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: ask + 人後面用 to + 動詞原形，所以寫 asked us to arrive。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: avoid 後面接名詞或動名詞，不接 to 不定詞。公式： avoid + 動名詞。正確對照：avoid loose wires，因為 loose wires 是名詞詞組。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: blamed the delay for a cancelled train
rules.correctPattern: blamed the delay on a cancelled train
rules.explanationZhHant: blame + 結果 + on + 原因：把延誤歸咎於火車取消。另一個正確結構是 blame the cancelled train for the delay。 兩個賓語角色不可倒轉。
correctExamples: blamed the delay on a cancelled train
incorrectExamples: blamed the delay for a cancelled train
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB BRIDGE CROSS ACTIVE
rules.incorrectPattern: No road bridge was crossed the river
rules.correctPattern: No road bridge crossed the river
rules.explanationZhHant: bridge 橫跨 river， 所以 cross 用主動式。被動式應由被跨越的事物作主語： The river was crossed by a bridge。
correctExamples: No road bridge crossed the river
incorrectExamples: No road bridge was crossed the river
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB CAUSE NP TO_INFINITIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: cause 表示導致某人處於某情況或做某事時，用 cause + 人 + to + 動詞原形。所以寫 causing staff to have...。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB COMPARE DIRECT_OBJECT NO_BETWEEN
rules.explanationZhHant: compare 作動詞時直接接比較對象。名詞結構才使用 a comparison between A and B。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB COMPLAIN ABOUT PROBLEM
rules.explanationZhHant: 如果原意是「抱怨某個問題」，用 complain about + 問題。 blame 的結構不同： blame someone for something 或 blame something on someone。由於更換動詞可能改變意思，建議老師確認。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB CONGRATULATE NP ON
rules.explanationZhHant: 固定結構是 congratulate + 人 + on + 名詞／動名詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 實體路線連接兩個地點時，可用 connect A to B。 the public square 是已規劃的特定設施，需要 the。 connect A with B 也可成立。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: consider 表示「考慮做某事」時，後面接動名詞。公式： consider + 動名詞。邊界： consider the proposal 中， consider 可直接接名詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: contact 作動詞時直接接對象，所以寫 contacted support， 不加 with。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB CONTACT WH_INFINITIVE NO_PREPOSITION
rules.explanationZhHant: contact 是及物動詞，直接接賓語，因此在 whom to contact 前不加 to。對照： whom to speak to，因為 speak 需要介詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示建築物改作另一種用途，用 convert A into B；被動式為 A was converted into B。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB CREATE NP FOR_BENEFICIARY
rules.incorrectPattern: create parents and students economic difficulties
rules.correctPattern: create economic difficulties for parents and students
rules.explanationZhHant: create 先直接接被創造或造成的事物，再用 for 引出受影響的人： create + difficulties + for + people。不能把 parents and students 直接放在 economic difficulties 前作雙賓語。
correctExamples: create economic difficulties for parents and students
incorrectExamples: create parents and students economic difficulties
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: decide 後面通常接 to 不定詞，所以寫 decided to order。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: depend 的固定搭配是 depend on + 人／事物／分句。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: discuss 作動詞時直接接討論內容，所以寫 discussed the problem，不加 about。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 把一個整體分成多個部分，用 divide A into B。 divide between/among 可表示分配給不同人。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: enjoy 後面接動名詞，所以寫 enjoyed working， 不寫 enjoyed to work。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: exceed 是及物動詞，直接接被超越的對象： exceed the 0–14 age group。 表示比例上升至某個終點，則用另一個動詞 rise to 57.3%。 不能把兩個結構混合成 exceed X to 57.3%。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB EXPLAIN THING TO_PERSON
rules.incorrectPattern: explained new visitors the safety rules
rules.correctPattern: explained the safety rules to new visitors
rules.explanationZhHant: explain 先接所解釋的內容，再用 to 接聽者。公式： explain + 事情 + to + 人。正確替代： The coordinator told the visitors the safety rules，因為 tell 可使用雙賓語。
correctExamples: explained the safety rules to new visitors
incorrectExamples: explained new visitors the safety rules
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: face 表示朝向某地時直接接賓語，不加 to。 此處也需要 the 指已知的 medical centre。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示數值在兩個水平之間反覆變動，用 fluctuate between A and B。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB GIVE PASSIVE DIRECT_OBJECT NO_PREPOSITION
rules.explanationZhHant: 被動句中的 be given 可以直接接所給予的事物：be given places， 不加 at。 The lecture was given at the school 中的 at 表示活動地點，屬另一個結構。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB ILLUSTRATE DIRECT_OBJECT NO_ABOUT
rules.explanationZhHant: illustrate 是及物動詞，直接接所展示的內容，不加 about。對照： provide information about electricity use。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: imagine 後面可接動名詞，表示想像某個動作或情境： imagine entering a shop。也可寫 imagine that you enter a shop。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: increase by + 數值表示增加幅度。不能在這個意思下直接把數值放在不及物動詞後。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: increase to + 數值表示增加後的水平。 until 用於時間或某種持續界線。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: insist 後面接動作時，可用 on + 動名詞。公式： insist on + 名詞／動名詞。另一個正確結構是 insist that + 分句，例如 He insisted that we check every cable。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB LACK DIRECT_OBJECT NO_OF
rules.explanationZhHant: lack 作動詞時直接接賓語： lack access， 不加 of。 如果使用名詞 lack，則寫 a lack of access。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB LET NP BASE_VERB
rules.explanationZhHant: let 後面接人，再直接用動詞原形，不加 to。 公式：let + 人 + 動詞原形。正確對照：allow children to test， 因為 allow 需要 to 不定詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示建築物位於某處，動詞是 lie，過去式為 lay。laid 是及物動詞 lay 的過去式，例如 laid the map on the table。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB LINK A_WITH_B NO_BETWEEN
rules.incorrectPattern: linking between the main road and the station
rules.correctPattern: linking the main road with the station
rules.explanationZhHant: 動詞 link 使用 link A with/to B。名詞結構才可寫 a link between A and B。
correctExamples: linking the main road with the station
incorrectExamples: linking between the main road and the station
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: look forward to 裡面的 to 是介詞，所以後面的動作用動名詞。公式： look forward to + 名詞／動名詞。正確對照： hope to learn，因為 hope 後面的 to 是不定詞標記。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB MAKE NP BASE_VERB ACTIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: 主動句中的使役動詞 make 使用 make + 人 + 動詞原形，不加 to。邊界：被動句要恢復 to，例如 Everyone was made to wear eye protection。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 這裡 manage 表示「成功做到」，後面接 to 不定詞。公式： manage to + 動詞原形。邊界： manage a repair team 中， manage 可直接接名詞，意思是「管理」。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB MEAN GERUND ENTAIL
rules.explanationZhHant: mean doing 表示某件事必然涉及另一件事。更換卡片會涉及填寫另一張表格。 mean to do 則表示有意打算做某事。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB MEAN TO_INFINITIVE INTENTION
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示沒有打算延誤小組，用 mean to + 動詞原形。mean delaying 會表示某情況意味著延誤。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB OVERTAKE DIRECT_OBJECT NO_THAN
rules.explanationZhHant: overtake 是及物動詞，直接接被超越的對象，不使用 than。 become higher than 才需要 than。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB PREVENT NP FROM_GERUND
rules.explanationZhHant: prevent 後面先寫受影響的人或物，再用 from + 動名詞表示被阻止的動作。公式： prevent + 人／物 + from + 動名詞。邊界： prevent an accident 可直接接名詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB PRIORITISE DIRECT_OBJECT NO_ON
rules.explanationZhHant: prioritise 是及物動詞，直接接賓語： prioritise prevention。使用名詞 priority 時，才可寫 give priority to prevention。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB PROTECT NP FROM_NP
rules.correctPattern: protect them from excessive work and
rules.explanationZhHant: prevent + 人 + from 後面通常接動名詞，例如 prevent workers from overworking。若後面直接接名詞 excessive work，可改用 protect workers from excessive work。
correctExamples: protect them from excessive work and
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: access 在這裡不可數。固定結構是 provide access to + 地點／設施，不能把 path 和 access 當作雙賓語。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB PROVIDE NP WITH_NP
rules.incorrectPattern: provided every team by the necessary gloves
rules.correctPattern: provided every team with the necessary gloves
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示「為某人提供某物」可用 provide + 人 + with + 物。這裡不能用 by。另一個正確寫法是 provide the necessary gloves for every team。
correctExamples: provided every team with the necessary gloves
incorrectExamples: provided every team by the necessary gloves
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 正確配對是 range from A to B 或 range between A and B。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB REACH DIRECT_OBJECT NO_TO
rules.explanationZhHant: reach 是及物動詞，直接接數值，不加 to。對照： rise to 4.8 MWh。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: recover to + 數值表示回升後的水平。 recover by 0.4 MWh 可表示回升幅度。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB REMEMBER GERUND PAST_MEMORY
rules.explanationZhHant: remember doing 表示記得曾經做過某事。 remember to do 表示記得要做某事並執行。原意是她回想自己把卡留在巴士上，因此用動名詞。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: remind 直接接被提醒的人，不在前面加 to： remind everyone that...。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB REMIND NP TO_INFINITIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: remind 通常要指出提醒的對象。這裡 them 指上一句的 new visitors。 公式： remind + 人 + to + 動詞原形。邊界： remember to write 表示主語自己記得做某事。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB REQUEST DIRECT_OBJECT NO_FOR
rules.explanationZhHant: request 作及物動詞時直接接所要求的事物： request more information。名詞結構則可寫 a request for information。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB REQUEST WORK DIRECT_OBJECT
rules.explanationZhHant: request 作動詞時需要直接賓語。本句可寫 request work on urgent projects。更清楚的替代寫法是 ask employees to work on urgent projects。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB REQUIRE NP TO_INFINITIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: require 表示要求某人做某事時，使用 require + 人 + to + 動詞原形。 require 已經控制後面的不定詞，不能加入 needed； to 後面亦要用原形 wear，不用過去式 wore。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: rise 是不及物動詞，表示數值自行上升。raise 是及物動詞，需要賓語，例如 The policy raised the total。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 描述圖表數列的初始數值，通常用 start at + 數值。時間範圍可寫 from 2005。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: stop to explain 表示停下原本的活動，目的是進行解釋；stop explaining 表示停止解釋。兩者都合文法，但意思不同，系統必須根據已記錄原意選擇。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB SURPASS DIRECT_OBJECT NO_THAN
rules.explanationZhHant: surpass 是及物動詞，直接接被超越的對象。 was higher than Northland 才使用 than。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：VERB TRY GERUND EXPERIMENT
rules.explanationZhHant: try doing 表示嘗試某個方法，看看是否有效；try to do 表示努力完成某事。兩者均可能正確，必須按語境處理。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: and its site will turn to
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示地點轉變成另一種用途，用 turn into 或 become。 turn to 常表示轉向某人、某方法或某頁。
incorrectExamples: and its site will turn to
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: used to 表示過去的習慣或狀態，後面用動詞原形。公式：used to + 動詞原形。邊界：be used to + 名詞／動名詞，例如 She is used to working late。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 當 difference 本身逐漸擴大時， widen 作不及物動詞。被動式暗示有外在執行者把差距擴大，因此這項規則應保留原意檢查。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: would rather to donate unused tools than throwing them away
rules.correctPattern: would rather donate unused tools than throw them away
rules.explanationZhHant: would rather 後面用動詞原形； than 後面的平行動作也用動詞原形。這是一組相依修改。公式： would rather + 動詞原形 + than + 動詞原形。邊界： would prefer to donate 中則保留 to。
correctExamples: would rather donate unused tools than throw them away
incorrectExamples: would rather to donate unused tools than throwing them away
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: beside／ next to 表示在旁邊； besides 表示「此外」或「除……之外」。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: communication 表示人與人之間的溝通，通常作不可數名詞。 commutation 是另一個真實英文詞，可表示減刑、換向或付款轉換，不是本句意思。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 本句描述的是兩國人口年齡結構之間的差異，因此 contrast 較能準確指回前面的比較。 pattern 本身不是文法錯誤，但未清楚表示哪一種模式正在改變。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：WORDCHOICE EMPLOYEE AFFECTED_WORKER NOT_EMPLOYER
rules.explanationZhHant: employer 是僱主， employee 是僱員。下文說這些人的僱主在非工作時間給他們工作，因此原意很可能是 employees。不過這項修改涉及人物角色，系統應先根據上下文判斷，不宜只靠單句自動更改。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示「試想一下」要用動詞 imagine。 image 作動詞可表示為某物成像或想像其圖像，但 imaged 是過去式，不能在這個祈使句位置使用。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: relieve stress 表示減輕壓力。 relive 表示重新經歷某件事，例如 relive a childhood memory。 兩詞拼法接近，但意思不同。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：WORDFORM ADVERB FAIRLY MODIFIES_VERB
rules.explanationZhHant: fairly 是副詞，在此修飾動詞 represented。 fair 是形容詞，通常描述名詞或放在連繫動詞後。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: density 是名詞；在這裡要用形容詞比較級 denser 描述 neighbourhood。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 修飾位置關係 opposite 要用副詞 diagonally，不用形容詞 diagonal。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：WORDFORM DRESS FREELY ADVERB
rules.explanationZhHant: dress 在這裡是不及物動詞，可用副詞 freely 修飾。 with 後面需要賓語，例如 dress with greater variety； 原句的 with for 不能構成一個完整結構。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示收入較低的家庭，常用複合形容詞 low-income， 放在名詞前時加連字號。文章泛指多個家庭，因此用 families，並在句首短語後加逗號。 low 是根據「沉重負擔」推斷，需老師確認。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：WORDFORM MAKE OBJECT ADJECTIVE
rules.explanationZhHant: make + 人／物 + 形容詞。 me 後面要用形容詞 confident，不用名詞 confidence。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: widely 是副詞，在這裡修飾 shared，表示利益廣泛地被分享。 wide 可在 open wide 或 far and wide 等結構中作副詞，但本句需要 widely。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: neighbour 是名詞，通常指人或相鄰事物；修飾位置接近的 riverbank 可用形容詞 nearby 或 neighbouring。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 放在名詞 edge 前作修飾語時，使用形容詞 northern。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: crises 前面需要形容詞 medical， 表示「醫療方面的」。 medicine 是名詞，雖然可在 medicine cabinet 等固定組合中修飾另一名詞，但不適用於 medical crisis。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: open space 指未被建築物佔用的公共空間。opened 是動詞過去分詞，表示某物已被打開。open spaces 也可用於多個獨立空間。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 把道路改為行人專用區，標準地圖描述動詞是 pedestrianise。made pedestria n-only 也是正確替代。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: respectively 表示兩組依次列出的項目一一對應。 respectably 表示以可敬或尚算不錯的方式，意思不同。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: youngster 指一名年輕人，不能自然地表示三個年齡分類中最年輕的一組。使用最高級形容詞 youngest 修飾 age group。
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.incorrectPattern: they work become slower and slower
rules.correctPattern: they work more and more slowly
rules.explanationZhHant: work 是動作，應由副詞 slowly 修飾。表示動作逐漸變慢，用 more and more slowly。 become slower 可描述人或事物的狀態，但不能直接放在 they work 後形成雙重謂語。
correctExamples: they work more and more slowly
incorrectExamples: they work become slower and slower
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Abstract category in which
rules.explanationZhHant: 正式圖表寫作中，可用 category in which。category where 在非正式英文中也可見，不宜設為絕對高置信度錯誤。 [規則族：GF_ABSTRACT_CATEGORY_IN_WHICH；來源規則：CLAUSE.ABSTRACT_CATEGORY.IN_WHICH.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Accompany takes a direct object in the active voice
rules.explanationZhHant: accompany 是及物動詞，直接接同行的人或物，不加 with。be accompanied by 則是被動結構。 [規則族：GF_ACCOMPANY_DIRECT_OBJECT；來源規則：VERB.ACCOMPANY.DIRECT_OBJECT.NO_WITH.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Account for a stated proportion
rules.explanationZhHant: account for 表示構成某個比例。 [規則族：GF_ACCOUNT_FOR_PROPORTION；來源規則：PHRASAL.ACCOUNT_FOR.PROPORTION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：After modal base verb
rules.explanationZhHant: could 後面使用動詞原形 choose，不用過去式 chose。 [規則族：GF_AFTER_MODAL_BASE_VERB；來源規則：MODAL.AFTER_MODAL.BASE_VERB.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：After which as an integrated sentential sequencer
rules.explanationZhHant: after which 指回前面的整個步驟，並連接下一個完整分句。也可使用句號後另寫 After that, ...。 [規則族：GF_AFTER_WHICH_SENTENTIAL_SEQUENCE；來源規則：CLAUSE.AFTER_WHICH.SEQUENCE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 固定比較結構是 ahead of + 對象，不用 than。 [規則族：GF_AHEAD_OF；來源規則：PREP.AHEAD_OF.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Although before a finite clause; despite before a nominal or gerund
rules.explanationZhHant: although 後面接完整分句；despite 後面接名詞或動名詞。 [規則族：GF_ALTHOUGH_FINITE_VS_DESPITE_NOMINAL；來源規則：CONJ.ALTHOUGH.FINITE.NOT_DESPITE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示某選項在一個多人群體中最受歡迎，用 among。between 主要連接兩個明確項目。 [規則族：GF_AMONG_GROUP；來源規則：PREP.AMONG.GROUP.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Another selects one singular member of an open set
rules.explanationZhHant: 單數可數名詞前表示另一個，用 another。other 通常配複數名詞或帶另一限定詞。 [規則族：GF_ANOTHER_SINGULAR_COUNT_NOUN；來源規則：DETERMINER.ANOTHER.SINGULAR_NOUN.v1, DETERMINER.ANOTHER.SINGULAR_OPEN_SET.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：As many as plural count
rules.explanationZhHant: women 是複數可數名詞，因此使用 as many as。as much as 修飾不可數名詞。 [規則族：GF_AS_MANY_AS_PLURAL_COUNT；來源規則：QUANTIFIER.AS_MANY_AS.PLURAL_COUNT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 固定比較短語是 as opposed to。 [規則族：GF_AS_OPPOSED_TO；來源規則：PREP.AS_OPPOSED_TO.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：At the bottom of for a location at a container boundary
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示位於容器底部的位置，通常使用 at the bottom of。in the bottom 可指物體內部的底層部分，語意不同。 [規則族：GF_AT_BOTTOM_LOCATION；來源規則：PREP.AT_THE_BOTTOM_OF.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Hyphenate a multiword attributive compound under the selected style guide
rules.explanationZhHant: quality-control 共同放在 tests 前作複合修飾語，因此加連字號。two tests for quality control 也是可接受替代。 [規則族：GF_ATTRIBUTIVE_COMPOUND_HYPHENATION；來源規則：NOUN.QUALITY_CONTROL.ATTRIBUTIVE_COMPOUND.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Capable of a noun or gerund
rules.explanationZhHant: 固定結構是 capable of + 名詞／動名詞。 [規則族：GF_CAPABLE_OF_GERUND；來源規則：ADJ.CAPABLE.OF.GERUND.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Plural count noun after a cardinal greater than one or several
rules.explanationZhHant: 大於一的數字後使用複數可數名詞。 [規則族：GF_CARDINAL_COUNT_NOUN_PLURAL；來源規則：ARTICLE.ORDINAL.PLURAL_POSITIONS.v1, COUNT.NUMBER.OF_EMPLOYEES.v1, FRACTION.OF_THE_TOTAL_SELECTIONS.v1, NOUN.NUMERAL.PLURAL.v1, NOUN.NUMERAL.PLURAL_SELECTIONS.v1, NOUN.SEVERAL.PLURAL.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Category record active figure
rules.explanationZhHant: 在圖表描述中，某類別可主動「錄得」一個數值：Private insurance recorded...。被動式需要改換主語。 [規則族：GF_CATEGORY_RECORD_ACTIVE_FIGURE；來源規則：VERB.CATEGORY.RECORD.ACTIVE_FIGURE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：A category is selected by respondents; by introduces the agent
rules.explanationZhHant: 被動句中選擇該項目的執行者由 by 引出。from 可引出來源或選項集合。 [規則族：GF_CATEGORY_SELECTION_PASSIVE_BY_AGENT；來源規則：PASSIVE.AGENT.BY_RESPONDENTS.v1, PASSIVE.CATEGORY.WAS_SELECTED_BY.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Close to each other
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示兩個數值接近，用 close to each other。 [規則族：GF_CLOSE_TO_EACH_OTHER；來源規則：ADJ.CLOSE.TO_EACH_OTHER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Collect from a source
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示物品的來源，用 collect from + 地點／人。out of 強調從內部移出。 [規則族：GF_COLLECT_FROM_SOURCE；來源規則：PREP.COLLECT.FROM_SOURCE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Combine one entity with another
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示兩種材料混合，用 combine A with B。被動式為 A is combined with B。 [規則族：GF_COMBINE_WITH_COTHEME；來源規則：PREP.COMBINE.WITH.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Combined categories and together
rules.explanationZhHant: 要把兩項的數值相加，可用 A and B together。together with 不一定把兩者組成同等並列主語。 [規則族：GF_COMBINED_CATEGORIES_AND_TOGETHER；來源規則：PARALLEL.COMBINED_CATEGORIES.AND_TOGETHER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Compared with introduces the intended comparison baseline
rules.explanationZhHant: 補充比較另一組數值時，可使用過去分詞短語 compared with。原名詞結構並非絕對錯誤，但在此句中較笨重。 [規則族：GF_COMPARED_WITH_SUPPLEMENT；來源規則：PARTICIPLE.COMPARED_WITH.BASELINE.v1, PARTICIPLE.COMPARED_WITH.FIGURE.v1, PARTICIPLE.COMPARED_WITH.SUPPLEMENT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：No declarative that immediately before an embedded wh-clause
rules.explanationZhHant: illustrate 後面可直接接由 how 引出的內容分句，不同時使用 that how。對照：illustrates that the process is efficient。 [規則族：GF_COMPLEMENTIZER_WH_EXCLUSION；來源規則：CLAUSE.ILLUSTRATE.WH_CLAUSE.NO_THAT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Contextual mass-noun number for undifferentiated substances or material
rules.explanationZhHant: wastewater 表示廢水整體時通常不可數。不同類別可寫 types of wastewater。 [規則族：GF_CONTEXTUAL_MASS_NOUN_NUMBER；來源規則：COUNT.WASTEWATER.UNCOUNTABLE.v1, COUNT.MATERIAL.GENERIC_UNCOUNTABLE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Explicit conjunction before the final item in a prose list
rules.explanationZhHant: 三項並列時，最後一項前用 and。若使用 as well as，必須完整寫出。 [規則族：GF_COORDINATE_LIST_FINAL_CONJUNCTION；來源規則：CONJ.LIST.FINAL_AND.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 這裡只是列出兩個平行數值，用 and。beside 表示空間位置。 [規則族：GF_COORDINATED_FIGURES_AND；來源規則：CONJ.COORDINATED_FIGURES.AND.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Adjective, not manner adverb, as terminal copular complement
rules.explanationZhHant: are 是連繫動詞，後面使用形容詞 mechanical 描述 stages，不用副詞 mechanically。 [規則族：GF_COPULAR_COMPLEMENT_ADJECTIVE；來源規則：LINKING.BE.ADJECTIVE.MECHANICAL.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Count noun number follows the construed number of referents
rules.explanationZhHant: 比較多組偏好時中心名詞用複數；比較關係用 between；不同選項的偏好用複數 preferences。 [規則族：GF_COUNT_NOUN_NUMBER；來源規則：NOUN.COMPARISONS.BETWEEN.PREFERENCES.v1, PREP.SIZES.OF_THE_TWO_GROUPS.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Definite article for an already established comparison group or figure
rules.explanationZhHant: 這裡指前文已知的男性和女性兩組，因此使用 the。 [規則族：GF_DEFINITE_COMPARISON_REFERENT；來源規則：ARTICLE.DEFINED_FEMALE_FIGURE.THE.v1, ARTICLE.DEFINED_GROUP_TOTAL.THE.v1, ARTICLE.DEFINED_MALE_FIGURE.THE.v1, ARTICLE.DEFINED_TWO_GROUPS.THE.v1, ARTICLE.MULTIPLIER.DEFINED_BASE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Definite article for a previously introduced processed batch
rules.explanationZhHant: 指前文已處理並乾燥的那批 flakes，使用 the。 [規則族：GF_DEFINITE_PROCESSED_REFERENT；來源規則：ARTICLE.DEFINED.PROCESSED_MATERIAL.THE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Use an adverb as a degree modifier of an adjective, comparison, or value
rules.explanationZhHant: 修飾數字用副詞 approximately；數字後的比例單位使用不變形式 per cent。 [規則族：GF_DEGREE_ADVERB_FORM；來源規則：PREP.FLUCTUATE.AROUND.AVERAGE.v1, WORDFORM.APPROXIMATELY.NUMBER.v1, WORDFORM.APPROXIMATELY.PER_CENT.v1, WORDFORM.BROADLY_COMPARABLE.v1, WORDFORM.SLIGHTLY.MORE_THAN.v1, WORDFORM.SLIGHTLY_OVER.v1, WORDFORM.VIRTUALLY_UNCHANGED.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: different 是形容詞；本句需要名詞主語 difference。 [規則族：GF_DIFFERENT_TO_DIFFERENCE；來源規則：WORDFORM.DIFFERENT_TO_DIFFERENCE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Each of numeral set
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示六項中的每一項，用 each of + 數字 + 複數名詞。 [規則族：GF_EACH_OF_NUMERAL_SET；來源規則：DETERMINER.EACH_OF.NUMERAL_SET.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Singular count noun after determiner each
rules.explanationZhHant: each 和 every 後面都接單數名詞。目標使用 each employee，強調每人可作多項選擇。 [規則族：GF_EACH_SINGULAR_COUNT_NOUN；來源規則：DETERMINER.EACH.SINGULAR_NOUN.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Either of two groups
rules.explanationZhHant: 否定句中的「兩組任何一組」使用 either。資料位於某組內，用 in。 [規則族：GF_EITHER_OF_TWO_GROUPS；來源規則：DETERMINER.EITHER.OF_TWO_GROUPS.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 所有格 the men's 可省略已出現的 total。the one of men 不是自然的所有格省略。 [規則族：GF_ELLIPSIS_MENS_TOTAL；來源規則：POSSESSIVE.ELLIPSIS.MENS_TOTAL.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Exceed active direct object
rules.explanationZhHant: 主語是 the male figure，它主動超過 female figure，因此不用被動助動詞 was。 [規則族：GF_EXCEED_ACTIVE_DIRECT_OBJECT；來源規則：VERB.EXCEED.ACTIVE.DIRECT_OBJECT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Fail takes a test as its direct object
rules.explanationZhHant: fail 表示未能通過某項測試時，直接接賓語，不加 from。 [規則族：GF_FAIL_TEST_DIRECT_OBJECT；來源規則：VERB.FAIL.DIRECT_OBJECT.TEST.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Fewer plural count noun
rules.explanationZhHant: women 是可數名詞複數，所以用 fewer。 [規則族：GF_FEWER_PLURAL_COUNT_NOUN；來源規則：QUANTIFIER.FEWER.PLURAL_COUNT_NOUN.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Insert an agreeing be auxiliary for a finite passive predicate
rules.explanationZhHant: categories 是被排列的項目，因此需要被動助動詞 are。 [規則族：GF_FINITE_PASSIVE_INSERT_AUXILIARY；來源規則：PASSIVE.PRESENT.ARE_TRANSPORTED.v1, PASSIVE.MOULDS.ARE_REPAIRED.ADVERB.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Gerund for an action complement governed by for
rules.explanationZhHant: for 是介詞，後面的動作用動名詞：sent for shredding。另一個正確寫法是 sent to be shredded。 [規則族：GF_FOR_ACTION_COMPLEMENT_GERUND；來源規則：VERB.SEND.FOR.GERUND_PROCESS.v1, PREP.FOR.GERUND.REPROCESSING.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Replace for plus bare verb with a purpose infinitive
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示檢查的目的，用 to + 動詞原形：inspected to determine...。 [規則族：GF_FOR_BASE_PURPOSE_TO_INFINITIVE；來源規則：INFINITIVE.PURPOSE.INSPECT_TO_DETERMINE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：For introduces an elapsed duration; during introduces an event
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示持續時間的長度，用 for + 時段。during 後面接事件或時期，如 during the drying stage。 [規則族：GF_FOR_MEASURED_DURATION；來源規則：PREP.FOR.DURATION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Whether preferred for an explicit binary embedded alternative in formal prose
rules.explanationZhHant: 正式寫作中，表示測試兩種可能結果，使用 whether。if 在部分間接問句中可成立，但在 measure whether 中較標準。 [規則族：GF_FORMAL_WHETHER_PREFERENCE；來源規則：CLAUSE.FORMAL_EMBEDDED.WHETHER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Plural denominator in non-unit common fractions
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示略高於某比例，常用 just over。分子為二，分母用複數 fifths。 [規則族：GF_FRACTION_DENOMINATOR_PLURAL；來源規則：FRACTION.JUST_OVER.TWO_FIFTHS.v1, FRACTION.PLURAL_DENOMINATOR.v1, FRACTION.THREE_QUARTERS.PLURAL.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：A fraction selects an of-complement naming its base
rules.explanationZhHant: 分數的整體基數由 of 引出；特定的 370 項用 the，名詞用複數。 [規則族：GF_FRACTION_OF_BASE；來源規則：FRACTION.OF_THE_TOTAL_SELECTIONS.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Fraction of total attributive female
rules.explanationZhHant: 比例基數由 of 引出；名詞前作修飾語用單數形容詞形式 female。 [規則族：GF_FRACTION_OF_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTIVE_FEMALE；來源規則：PREP.FRACTION.OF_TOTAL_ATTRIBUTIVE_FEMALE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：During introduces the event in which a by-product is generated
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示廢水在清洗階段產生，用 during washing。generated from 可引出產生它的原材料或來源。 [規則族：GF_GENERATED_DURING_EVENT；來源規則：PREP.GENERATED.DURING.PROCESS.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：In introduces a chart category as the domain of a contrast or value
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示某種差異出現在某一類別中，用 in。 [規則族：GF_IN_CATEGORY；來源規則：PREP.CONTRAST.APPEAR_IN_CATEGORY.v1, PREP.IN_A_CATEGORY.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 固定連接語是複數 in other words。 [規則族：GF_IN_OTHER_WORDS；來源規則：FIXED.IN_OTHER_WORDS.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Instead of plus noun or gerund, including passive being plus participle
rules.explanationZhHant: 固定結構是 instead of + 名詞／動名詞。被動形式為 instead of being + 過去分詞。 [規則族：GF_INSTEAD_OF_GERUND；來源規則：PREP.INSTEAD_OF.PASSIVE_GERUND.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Use men and women as irregular plurals without an added s
rules.explanationZhHant: woman 的複數是 women。number of 後面接複數可數名詞。 [規則族：GF_IRREGULAR_MAN_WOMAN_PLURAL；來源規則：NOUN.IRREGULAR.MAN_MEN.NO_S.v1, NOUN.IRREGULAR.MAN_MEN.v1, NOUN.IRREGULAR.WOMAN_WOMEN.NO_S.v1, NOUN.IRREGULAR.WOMAN_WOMEN.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 指本句已討論的特定 gym membership benefit，使用 the。 [規則族：GF_KNOWN_BENEFIT_THE；來源規則：ARTICLE.KNOWN_BENEFIT.THE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Leave a patient to undergo an autonomous state change
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示讓材料自行冷卻，用 leave + 物件 + to + 動詞原形。leave something cooling 在特定動態語境可能成立，但不是本程序的預定階段寫法。 [規則族：GF_LEAVE_PATIENT_TO_INFINITIVE；來源規則：CAUSATIVE.LEAVE.OBJECT.TO_INFINITIVE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Less adjective not fewer
rules.explanationZhHant: popular 是形容詞，其較低程度用 less。fewer 只修飾複數可數名詞。 [規則族：GF_LESS_ADJECTIVE_NOT_FEWER；來源規則：DEGREE.LESS.ADJECTIVE.NOT_FEWER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 固定搭配是 make a selection／make selections，不用 do selections。 [規則族：GF_MAKE_A_SELECTION；來源規則：COLLOC.MAKE_A_SELECTION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示某群體構成整體的比例，用 make up。 [規則族：GF_MAKE_UP_PROPORTION；來源規則：PHRASAL.MAKE_UP.PROPORTION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 圖表中表示男性數值較高，可簡潔寫 a male advantage。原結構可理解，宜設為寫法建議而非硬性錯誤。 [規則族：GF_MALE_ADVANTAGE_CATEGORY；來源規則：COLLOC.MALE_ADVANTAGE.CATEGORY.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Adverb form for a manner modifier of a verb
rules.explanationZhHant: 修飾動詞 ranked 使用副詞 separately。 [規則族：GF_MANNER_ADVERB_FORM；來源規則：PASSIVE.MOULDS.ARE_REPAIRED.ADVERB.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：By introduces the size of a difference or change
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示多出多少，用 outnumber A by + 差額／比例。 [規則族：GF_MARGIN_BY_AMOUNT；來源規則：COMP.BY_FEWER_THAN.COUNT_NOUN.v1, PREP.EXCEED.BY_MARGIN.v1, PREP.OUTNUMBER.BY_MARGIN.v1, VERB.NARROW.BY_AMOUNT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Mark an item with information
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示產品上標有某項資料，用 marked with + 資料。marked by 可表示某時期以某特徵著稱。 [規則族：GF_MARK_WITH_INFORMATION；來源規則：PREP.MARK.WITH.INFORMATION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Plural measurement unit after a non-unit number
rules.explanationZhHant: 數值大於一時使用複數 degrees Celsius。作前置複合修飾語時可寫 an 80-degree chamber。 [規則族：GF_MEASUREMENT_UNIT_NUMBER；來源規則：UNIT.DEGREES.CELSIUS.PLURAL.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示超過某分數，使用 more than + 分數。 [規則族：GF_MORE_THAN_FRACTION；來源規則：QUANTIFIER.MORE_THAN.FRACTION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：More than one selects a singular count noun
rules.explanationZhHant: 比較詞是 than；固定結構 more than one 後面使用單數名詞。 [規則族：GF_MORE_THAN_ONE_SINGULAR；來源規則：QUANTIFIER.MORE_THAN_ONE.SINGULAR.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：To for a realized motion destination
rules.explanationZhHant: to 引出運送目的地；at 表示物件已位於該地點。 [規則族：GF_MOTION_REALIZED_DESTINATION_TO；來源規則：PREP.TRANSPORT.TO_DESTINATION.v1, PREP.TO.DEFINITE_ENDPOINT.v1, PREP.TRANSPORT.TO.DESTINATION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Multiplier three times base
rules.explanationZhHant: 若女性數值是男性數值的三倍，應寫 three times the male figure。three times higher than 可能被解讀為四倍，倍數意思不安全。 [規則族：GF_MULTIPLIER_THREE_TIMES_BASE；來源規則：COMP.MULTIPLIER.THREE_TIMES_BASE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Number of, not amount of, quantifies plural countable people
rules.explanationZhHant: employees 是複數可數名詞，因此使用 number。amount 修飾不可數名詞，如 the amount of money。 [規則族：GF_NUMBER_OF_COUNT_PEOPLE；來源規則：COUNT.NUMBER.OF_EMPLOYEES.v1, COUNT.NUMBER.OF_PEOPLE.NOT_AMOUNT.v1, NOUN.NUMBER_OF.PASSENGERS.ORDER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Singular unit noun in numeral compound modifier
rules.explanationZhHant: 數字和名詞共同放在另一名詞前作修飾語時，名詞保持單數：a twelve-stage process。 [規則族：GF_NUMERAL_ATTRIBUTIVE_NOUN_SINGULAR；來源規則：NOUN.NUMERAL.COMPOUND.SINGULAR_STAGE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 差額數字放在比較級前：80 higher than。 [規則族：GF_NUMERAL_BEFORE_COMPARATIVE；來源規則：COMP.NUMERAL_BEFORE_COMPARATIVE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Numeral plus more plus count noun plus than comparison
rules.explanationZhHant: 差額放在 more 前：60 more women than men。比較對象由 than 引出。 [規則族：GF_NUMERAL_MORE_COUNT_NOUN_THAN；來源規則：COMP.NUMERAL_MORE_NOUN_THAN.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 表示某類別位居某一名次，可用 occupy + position/place。locate 通常表示找出或設置實體位置。 [規則族：GF_OCCUPY_RANK_POSITION；來源規則：VERB.OCCUPY.RANK_POSITION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Well-formed finite or adjectival clause after once
rules.explanationZhHant: once 後可接完整分句 once they are clean，或縮減為 once clean。once cleaning 會錯誤地表示瓶子主動清洗其他東西。 [規則族：GF_ONCE_CLAUSE_REDUCTION；來源規則：CLAUSE.ONCE.FINITE_OR_ADJECTIVE.v1, CLAUSE.ONCE.ADJECTIVE.REDUCTION.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：One sixth of base
rules.explanationZhHant: 分數所參照的基數由 of 引出：one sixth of the male figure。 [規則族：GF_ONE_SIXTH_OF_BASE；來源規則：FRACTION.ONE_SIXTH.OF_BASE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Only singular category the
rules.explanationZhHant: only 界定唯一的一項，單數名詞前使用 the。 [規則族：GF_ONLY_SINGULAR_CATEGORY_THE；來源規則：ARTICLE.ONLY.SINGULAR_CATEGORY.THE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: opposite 表示與剛提及模式相反的那一種特定模式，因此用 the。 [規則族：GF_OPPOSITE_PATTERN_THE；來源規則：ARTICLE.OPPOSITE_PATTERN.THE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 比較兩群人的人數時，用 outnumber + 人群。exceed 通常由數值或數量作主語，如 the female figure exceeded...。 [規則族：GF_OUTNUMBER_PEOPLE；來源規則：VERB.OUTNUMBER.PEOPLE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: overall 可直接作副詞，表示整體而言，不在前面加 in。 [規則族：GF_OVERALL_NO_IN；來源規則：ADVERB.OVERALL.NO_IN.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Pack in groups of a stated size
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示包裝的分組方式，用 in groups of + 數字。 [規則族：GF_PACK_IN_GROUPS；來源規則：PREP.PACK.IN.GROUPS_OF.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Rewrite a heavy eventive participial premodifier as a relative clause
rules.explanationZhHant: 長而複雜的現在分詞片語不能自然放在 blocks 前。使用後置關係分句可清楚表示是 blocks 通過測試。 [規則族：GF_PARTICIPIAL_PREMODIFIER_ATTACHMENT；來源規則：CLAUSE.PARTICIPIAL_PREMODIFIER.MISATTACHMENT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Past participle after passive be
rules.explanationZhHant: heat 是被施加的事物，所以使用現在被動語態 is applied。 [規則族：GF_PASSIVE_BE_PAST_PARTICIPLE；來源規則：PASSIVE.PRESENT.HEAT.IS_APPLIED.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Passive cannot be used
rules.explanationZhHant: chart 是被用來計算的工具，所以使用情態動詞被動語態。 [規則族：GF_PASSIVE_CANNOT_BE_USED；來源規則：MODAL.PASSIVE.CANNOT_BE_USED.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Along for motion following a linear support
rules.explanationZhHant: 物件沿着輸送帶移動，用 along。through 表示從某空間或通道內部穿過。 [規則族：GF_PATH_ALONG_LINEAR_SUPPORT；來源規則：PREP.TRAVEL.ALONG.CONVEYOR.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Have been plus past participle for perfect passive
rules.explanationZhHant: surfaces 是被塗油的事物，現在完成式被動使用 have been + 過去分詞。 [規則族：GF_PERFECT_PASSIVE_INSERT_BEEN；來源規則：PASSIVE.PRESENT_PERFECT.HAVE_BEEN_COATED.v1, PASSIVE.PRESENT_PERFECT.MOULDS_FILLED.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：On for placement in contact with a supporting surface
rules.explanationZhHant: 物件放在托盤表面，用 on。over 表示在上方但未必接觸。 [規則族：GF_PLACE_ON_CONTACT_SURFACE；來源規則：PREP.PLACE.ON.SURFACE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Possessive pronoun agrees with its coreferent
rules.explanationZhHant: 所有格指回複數 flakes，因此使用 their。 [規則族：GF_POSSESSIVE_PRONOUN_NUMBER_AGREEMENT；來源規則：PRONOUN.PLURAL_FLAKES.THEIR.v1, PRONOUN.PLURAL_BLOCKS.THEIR.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Into for caused motion entering a container
rules.explanationZhHant: 液體由外部進入容器，用 pour into。in 表示已在容器內。 [規則族：GF_POUR_INTO_CONTAINER；來源規則：PREP.POUR.INTO.CONTAINER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Under or at a pressure, not with a pressure
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示物件承受某個壓力，用 under a pressure of + 數值。也可寫 compressed at a pressure of...。 [規則族：GF_PRESSURE_PREPOSITION_FRAME；來源規則：PREP.UNDER.A_PRESSURE_OF.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Prior to plus gerund, or before plus gerund
rules.explanationZhHant: prior 若作介詞短語，必須寫 prior to + 動名詞。較簡單的寫法是 before authorising。 [規則族：GF_PRIOR_TO_OR_BEFORE_GERUND；來源規則：PREP.PRIOR_TO.OR_BEFORE_GERUND.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Begin/end with a named process stage
rules.explanationZhHant: 描述程序的第一個階段，常用 begin with + 名詞／動名詞。begin from 通常引出時間或空間起點。 [規則族：GF_PROCESS_BOUNDARY_WITH；來源規則：PROCESS.BEGIN.WITH.STAGE_NOUN.v1, PROCESS.END.WITH.STAGE_NOUN.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Mass-process versus count-event article construal
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示接受某種加工過程時，可寫 undergo washing/testing/treatment。若指一次獨立的清洗，可寫 undergo a wash。 [規則族：GF_PROCESS_NOUN_COUNT_CONSTRUAL；來源規則：VERB.UNDERGO.PROCESS_NOUN.ZERO_ARTICLE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Purpose infinitive preferred over for plus gerund after an action
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示塗油這個動作的具體目的，用 to + 動詞原形。for preventing 可在名詞用途描述中成立，但此處較不合適。 [規則族：GF_PURPOSE_TO_INFINITIVE_PREFERENCE；來源規則：INFINITIVE.PURPOSE.TO_PREVENT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：For introduces the group whose ranking is stated
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示屬於某組的排名，用 positions for women。 [規則族：GF_RANK_FOR_GROUP；來源規則：PREP.RANKING.FOR_GROUP.v1, RANK.FIFTH_FOR_GROUP.v1, SVA.SINGULAR_ORDER.FOR_GROUP.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Rank fourth no the
rules.explanationZhHant: rank fourth 中序數詞作排名補語，不加 the。名詞結構則寫 in fourth place。 [規則族：GF_RANK_FOURTH_NO_THE；來源規則：ADVERB.RANK.FOURTH.NO_THE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: rather than 可直接連接兩個平行名詞。若使用 instead，通常要寫 instead of percentages。 [規則族：GF_RATHER_THAN_COMPARISON；來源規則：CONJ.RATHER_THAN.COMPARISON.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Ratio of A to B
rules.explanationZhHant: 名詞 ratio 後用 of 引出比例的組成。 [規則族：GF_RATIO_OF_A_TO_B；來源規則：NOUN.RATIO.OF.COMPONENT.v1, NOUN.RATIO.A_TO_B.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Active present participle in a reduced relative clause
rules.explanationZhHant: mixture 主動溢出，所以縮減關係分句使用現在分詞 spilling。spilled 會暗示混合物被別人潑灑。 [規則族：GF_REDUCED_RELATIVE_VOICE_FORM；來源規則：CLAUSE.REDUCED_RELATIVE.ACTIVE.SPILLING.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Remove an incompatible path preposition before beneath
rules.explanationZhHant: beneath 已直接表示從磁鐵下方經過，不再加入 through。 [規則族：GF_REDUNDANT_PATH_PREPOSITION_STACK；來源規則：PREP.PASS.BENEATH.NO_THROUGH.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Until marks the event terminating a continuing state
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示一直留在某處，直至另一事件發生，用 remain...until...。before 只表達先後，不一定表示持續。 [規則族：GF_REMAIN_UNTIL_TERMINUS；來源規則：CONJ.REMAIN.UNTIL.EVENT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Remove an object from its origin or container
rules.explanationZhHant: remove + 物件 + from + 地點 表示把某物從一處移走。 [規則族：GF_REMOVE_FROM_ORIGIN；來源規則：PREP.REMOVE.FROM_SOURCE.v1, PREP.REMOVE.FROM.CONTAINER.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Time required to perform an action
rules.explanationZhHant: time 是收集瓶子所需要的時間，所以用過去分詞 required；其後接目的不定詞 to collect。 [規則族：GF_REQUIRED_TIME_REDUCED_PASSIVE；來源規則：CLAUSE.REDUCED_RELATIVE.PASSIVE.REQUIRED.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Resistance to a substance, force, or influence
rules.explanationZhHant: 固定搭配是 resistance to + 物質／力量。protection against water 則使用 against。 [規則族：GF_RESISTANCE_TO_FRAME；來源規則：NOUN.RESISTANCE.TO.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Into introduces the result of material transformation
rules.explanationZhHant: 把一個物件切成多個部分，用 cut + 物件 + into + 部分。 [規則族：GF_RESULTATIVE_INTO_FRAME；來源規則：VERB.CUT.NP.INTO_PARTS.v1, VERB.MELT.NP.INTO.RESULT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Resulting, not resulted, as an active attributive participle
rules.explanationZhHant: resulting 表示「由前一步產生的」。resulted 通常不直接作這種前置形容詞。 [規則族：GF_RESULTING_PARTICIPLE_MODIFIER；來源規則：PARTICIPLE.RESULTING.NOT_RESULTED.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Avoid redundant back after return in formal process prose
rules.explanationZhHant: return 本身已包含「回去」的意思，一般不再加入 back。非正式語言中可見，但正式 Task 1 宜避免。 [規則族：GF_RETURN_BACK_REDUNDANCY；來源規則：VERB.RETURN.NO_REDUNDANT_BACK.v1, VERB.RETURN.TO.STAGE.NO_BACK.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Return to a process stage
rules.explanationZhHant: return to + 階段／地點；return 已包含返回意思，且不使用 into 表示程序階段。 [規則族：GF_RETURN_TO_PROCESS_STAGE；來源規則：VERB.RETURN.TO.STAGE.NO_BACK.v1, PREP.RETURN.TO.PROCESS_STAGE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Scrape material off a surface
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示從表面刮走物料，用 scrape off。scrape out 表示從容器內部刮出。 [規則族：GF_SCRAPE_OFF_SURFACE；來源規則：PHRASAL.SCRAPE.OFF.SURFACE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Sizes of the groups uses an of-complement
rules.explanationZhHant: 名詞 sizes 用 of 引出所屬群組；已明確是兩組，因此使用 the two groups。 [規則族：GF_SIZES_OF_GROUPS_COMPLEMENT；來源規則：PREP.SIZES.OF_THE_TWO_GROUPS.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：So that before a finite result or purpose clause
rules.explanationZhHant: 後面是完整分句，使用 so that + 主語 + 動詞。so as to 後面則接動詞原形。 [規則族：GF_SO_THAT_FINITE_CLAUSE；來源規則：CONJ.SO_THAT.FINITE_RESULT.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.explanationZhHant: 指每項選擇所對應的特定百分比，使用 the。 [規則族：GF_SPECIFIC_PERCENTAGE_THE；來源規則：ARTICLE.SPECIFIC_PERCENTAGE.THE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Use simple present for a static chart or projection statement in Task 1
rules.explanationZhHant: 圖表數字恆常代表某種數據，用一般現在式。進行式不適合這種圖表功能描述。 [規則族：GF_STATIC_CHART_VERB_SIMPLE_PRESENT；來源規則：ASPECT.FIGURE.REPRESENT.SIMPLE_PRESENT.v1, ASPECT.PROJECTION.SIMPLE_PRESENT_SUGGEST.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：In for storage inside a building
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示存放在建築物內部，用 in。at the warehouse 可表示較概括的位置。 [規則族：GF_STORE_IN_INTERIOR；來源規則：PREP.STORE.IN.BUILDING.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Finite verb agrees with its syntactic subject
rules.explanationZhHant: flexible working hours 在這裡保留複數語法形式，因此被動助動詞使用 were。若圖例把它明確當作一個單一標籤，需記錄產品的標籤一致政策。 [規則族：GF_SUBJECT_VERB_NUMBER_AGREEMENT；來源規則：SVA.RELATIVE.SINGULAR_BATCH.REMAINS.v1, SVA.UNCOUNTABLE.WASTEWATER.SINGULAR.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Be subjected to a test or process
rules.explanationZhHant: 表示物件接受測試，用動詞被動結構 be subjected to。be subject to 也可表示受某條件支配，但不用 for。 [規則族：GF_SUBJECTED_TO_TEST_FRAME；來源規則：VERB.SUBJECT.NP.TO_TEST.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：With for applied substance; by for agent
rules.explanationZhHant: 用甚麼物質清洗，使用 with。by 可引出執行者或方法，如 washed by a machine。 [規則族：GF_SUBSTANCE_WITH_NOT_AGENT_BY；來源規則：PREP.WASH.WITH_SUBSTANCE.v1, PREP.COAT.WITH.SUBSTANCE.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：That or those agrees with the number of the omitted head
rules.explanationZhHant: 被代替的是單數名詞 number，所以用 that；those 代替複數。 [規則族：GF_SUBSTITUTE_PRONOUN_NUMBER_AGREEMENT；來源規則：REFERENCE.THAT.SINGULAR_FIGURE.v1, REFERENCE.THAT.SINGULAR_NUMBER.v1, REFERENCE.THOSE.PLURAL_FIGURES.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Attributive superlative normally takes the definite article
rules.explanationZhHant: 最高級通常由 the 限定。 [規則族：GF_SUPERLATIVE_DEFINITE_ARTICLE；來源規則：ARTICLE.SUPERLATIVE.THE.v1, PARALLEL.TWO_CATEGORIES.PLURAL_FIGURES.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

rules.titleZhHant: 文法規則：Present participle supplies a result supplement after a comma
rules.explanationZhHant: 逗號後用現在分詞補充前述兩個數值相加的結果。 [規則族：GF_SUPPLEMENTARY_RESULT_PRESENT_PARTICIPLE；來源規則：PARTICIPLE.RESULT.GIVING_TOTAL.v1, PARTICIPLE.RESULT.REACHING.v1, PARTICIPLE.RESULT.REMAINING.v1。]
rules.author: Edmund Sir

paragraphs.title: Neighbourhood Repair Café
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: Despite of receiving only a small grant, our neighbourhood repair café has become one of the most useful project in the district. It has operated since six months and used to offering help only with lamps, but it now accepts bicycles, radios and small kitchen machines. Many residents look forward to learn simple skills instead of throwing damaged objects away. Last Saturday, the volunteers managed fixing twenty items and prevented several batteries ending up in the rubbish. At the entrance, a coordinator carefully explained new visitors the safety rules and provided every team by the necessary gloves. She also reminded to write their names on a form before entering the workshop. Parents were happy because the organisers let children to test safe tools, although they made everyone to wear eye protection. One instructor advised avoiding to touch loose wires and suggested considering to replace any cracked plug. Another volunteer insisted checking each cable twice and said that he was responsible recording every repair. Most visitors prefer repairing old things than buying new ones, and several said they would rather to donate unused tools than throwing them away. The printed instructions were enough clear for beginners to follow, and the final demonstration was such practical that nobody became confused. At closing time, two students were responsible for both sorting spare parts and to clean the tables. Each visitor later chose between taking the item home or leaving it for collection. Between my neighbour and I, we carried the volunteers tools to a cupboard beside a resident who's bicycle had been repaired. The amount of volunteers was encouraging, while the others participants promised to return. By the time the doors closed, the final guest already left, the coordinator still had three forms to check before the next community event in early autumn.

paragraphs.title: Municipal Drainage Accountability Review
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: Following last winter’s floods, the council set out a panel to look into on why the drainage programme had fallen beneath schedule. The chair asked engineers to follow on every complaint and come up to a plan that would account about the failures. Not only several contractors failed to comply to the safety code, and they also tried to cover up about delays that should have been reported earlier. No sooner the investigators had drawn up on a timetable when one supplier pulled off of the project. Only after the financial records had been examined the panel ruled out against fraud. What it concerned residents most was that officials had put off replace pumps on that several low-lying districts depended. The committee recommended that each contractor provides monthly evidence and that emergency drills carried out twice a year. It is essential that the revised system is tested before the rainy season began, lest another breakdown leaves families without assistance. If had the council acted sooner, it might have prevented damage that is believed having cost local businesses millions. Much although the mayor wanted to defend the original scheme, she admitted that the authority had failed to live up with its promises. Residents would rather the council publishes all future reports than withholding inconvenient findings. By next June, the new monitoring team will take over of the temporary inspectors. However the repairs complicated may become, officials must deal about them transparently. Having reviewed the evidence, the conclusion was that what the city needs is not another short-term campaign but a permanent maintenance strategy. The more consistently agencies work together, similar failures are the less likely to recur. Until all recommendations will be implemented, no department can take it as granted that public confidence will simply return without sustained effort or scrutiny.

paragraphs.title: Preventive Health Policy
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: Good health policy should not begin at the hospital door. I completely agree with preventing illness is more important to treating it after it has already developed, and public funding should therefore give the strongest priority for prevention. The first reason is that prevention saves both money as human suffering. When governments invest on health education, vaccination programmes, early screening, safe parks, and better nutrition in schools, many serious conditions can stop before they become expensive medicine crises. A health system, that only responds after people are already sick, is always fighting fires: hospitals become crowded, doctors are overstretched, and taxpayers must pay long-term treatment that might have avoided. For example, if children are taught healthy eating habits and are given at places to exercise, they are less likely of developing obesity-related illnesses later at life. This means that fewer patients needing complex surgery, lifelong medication, or repeated hospital visits. Prevention, therefore, does not merely reduce costs; it protects people of pain that no medicine can fully erase it. Another reason is due to preventive spending creates a fairer society. Treatment often reaches people only after damage has done, whereas that prevention can protect whole communities before illness takes its root. This is especially important for poorer families, which may lack of access for nutritious food, safe housing, mental-health support, or regular medical checks. If public money is used to improve air quality, providing free health screenings, support school meals, and promote active lifestyles, the benefits are shared wide rather than reserve for those whom can afford for private care. In this sense, prevention is not just a medical strategy; it is a social investment that helps citizens remain healthily, productivity, and independently. In conclusion, governments should clearly prioritise on the prevention of disease because of it reduces avoidable suffering, lowering pressure to healthcare systems, and protects society more equally. Although treating illness matters, but preventing it is the more wiser use for public money.

paragraphs.title: Holiday Overwork and Employee Well-being
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: Nowadays, many employers blame on the phenomenon of overwork during holiday as their employers offer jobs for them apart from working hours. I highly believe that this problem has placed detrimental effects on workers, in terms of workloads, stress and social relationships. The most significant problem is that workers may suffer from higher workloads. As employers are able to connect with them at all times, they can offer job duties and request on urgent projects. As such, employers may sacrifice their holiday and take extra amount of work. Besides, working on holidays imposes high pressure on employees. Due to the fact that workers have to stay alert for phone calls from employers, they may devote less time on relaxation and be prepared for the request. As a result, they have less chance to relive their stress during holiday, and which may boost their anxiety under stress. Moreover, employees who need to work 247 may spend less time with their friends or partners. In addition to family gathering, employers who have to stay behind for work may devote less time in social activities. This generally destroys their social bonding with peers and draws on negative effects to their social relationships. However, some may judge that being connected with employers enhances their working efficiency. Workers who have difficulties can ask for advice from their employers and to receive immediate responses. But, as far as I am concerned, this is more beneficial to employers than workers, as they have no obligation to work on every occasion. Conversely, employers should respect their freedom and support workers during workdays. Also, workers should set boundaries for their working hours and avoid excessive workloads to keep themselves healthy. To sum up, employers should avoid contacting their workers during holiday, which can prevent them from excessive work, loads of stress and to keep close relationship with their friends.

Nowadays, messaging apps are common, causing staff to have a lot of email messages to reply to; since it is so convenient to manage documents and meetings, the end of the working day no longer feels like a real end. As a result, a person may be physically at home, but mentally still at the office desk. Another cause is financial pressure. Faced with high house prices, rising bus fares and food prices, people give up their free time and face heavy work stress just to keep their jobs. Over time, their bodies become tired as they work to make money. Because they do not have enough rest for a long time, they work more and more slowly and need more time to finish the work; after that, they lose their personal life. The most effective solution is for the government to limit the maximum working hours for certain jobs. For example, clerks and sales assistants can only work 6 days per week and 8 hours per day. Also, the employees can choose not to read or reply to the work messages after work, and their bosses cannot punish them or give them bad reviews for this. I hope this can help workers have more personal time and more rest time. At the same time, people should set clear boundaries for work. For example, after work, people can turn off work notifications and leave more time for doing exercise and having family dinners. Without such boundaries, personal life becomes the first thing to be sacrificed. In conclusion, work stress and financial pressure are closely connected to our standard of living and quality of life. However, if the government and employers provide better working conditions and individuals draw a clearer line between their jobs and the rest of their lives, this problem can be solved.

Over the period, its values ranged from 2.7 to 3.3 MWh. Westmere started at 2.1 MWh and increased by 1.1 MWh to 3.2 MWh. The 2035 figure is projected to be about one and a half times the 2005 level. Westmere remained below Southvale until 2025 but is projected to catch up with it by 2035. The bar chart presents the proportions of electricity generated from coal, gas and renewables. In 2005, coal made up 45 per cent of generation, gas 37 per cent and renewables 18 per cent. Coal's share is forecast to fall to 20 per cent, a decrease of 25 percentage points. This is equivalent to a reduction of 56 per cent relative to its share. Renewables are expected to rise from 18 to 47 per cent, gaining 29 percentage points. Their share will therefore be more than two and a half times its 2005 level. Wind and solar together will make up 47 per cent of total generation. Gas, by contrast, is projected to decline slightly, from 37 to 33 per cent. The gap between gas and renewables will shift from 19 percentage points favouring gas to 14 percentage points favouring renewables. Of the three sources, renewables will record the largest absolute increase. Coal will experience the sharpest fall of the three, while gas will remain the second-largest source. The figures for coal, gas and renewables will be 20, 33 and 47 per cent, respectively. Taken together, the charts indicate convergence in consumption and a shift towards renewable generation. Compared with 2005, the projected 2035 energy mix contains a much smaller coal share. The combined regional total is projected to rise from 12.1 to 14.3 MWh. The difference between the fastest-growing and slowest-growing regions is projected to widen. At the end of the period, Eastport will rank first, followed by Southvale and Westmere, with Northland last.

paragraphs.title: Recycled Plastic Paving Blocks
paragraphs.topicCategory: IELTS Academic Task 1 / Linear process diagram
paragraphs.incorrectParagraph: The diagram illustrates that how discarded plastic bottles are converted into paving blocks through a twelve-stages linear process. Overall, the procedure begins from collecting and inspecting used bottles and ends by packaging tested blocks. Most stages are mechanically, although heat is applying during melting and the material is left cooling before testing. First, bottles are collected out of households and transported at a recycling facility. On arrival, each bottle is inspected for determine whether it contains unsuitable material. Rejected items are removed off the production line, while the acceptable bottles travel through a conveyor belt. Labels and caps are then removed, after that the bottles undergo a washing by hot water and detergent. Once cleaning, the bottles are sent for shred. Rotating blades cut them to small flakes, which subsequently pass through beneath a magnet so as any metal fragments can be extracted. The flakes are dried during thirty minutes at 80 degree Celsius before to enter a heated chamber. This chamber, which is capable to reach 180 degrees Celsius, melts the flakes to a uniform liquid. Next, the molten plastic is combined to recycled sand in a ratio from three parts plastic against one part sand. Mechanical paddles continuously stir the two ingredients, preventing heavier particles settling in the bottom of the tank. The resulted mixture is poured in rectangular moulds which inner surfaces have coated by oil for preventing sticking. After the moulds have filled, they are compressed with a pressure of twelve tonnes during five minutes. The blocks are then left cooling at room temperature until completely solidifying. Once being solid, they are removed out from the moulds, and their edges are trimmed into producing an even shape. Before dried flakes enter the chamber, a sensor records its moisture level and diverts any batch that remain too wet. During moulding, excess mixture spilled over the sides is scraped out and returned back to the tank. A technician also records the temperature, pressure, as well processing time for each batches. These records accompany with the finished blocks toward the testing area, where inspectors compare the results with the factory standard prior authorising the batch for storage and delivery. Each block is subsequently subject for two tests of quality control. The first measures if the block can support the required load, while the second checks its resistance against water. Any block which fails from either test is returned back into the melting stage for reprocess. Passing both tests blocks are marked by its production date and packed by groups of twenty. Finally, the packaged blocks are placed over pallets, wrapped by protective film and stored at a dry warehouse. They remain there before they transported towards construction sites. The complete process is taken approximately six hours for completing, excluding the time requiring for collecting the bottles. Wastewaters generated from washing are filtered and reused, while damaged moulds repair separate. Thus, despite the procedure is linear, some rejected materials and water are returned into earlier stages instead to be discarded.

issues.explanationZhHant: many 後面的可數名詞通常要用複數，所以寫 companies。
companies 是複數主語，現在式動詞用 require，不加 s。
staff 通常是集合名詞。可寫 staff 或 staff members，一般不寫 staffs。
to 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 to wear。
policy 是第三身單數，所以使用 has。
several 後面要接可數名詞複數，所以是 advantages。
這裡泛指顧客這個群體，所以使用 customers。
can 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 can identify。
they 是複數主語，所以使用 need，不加 s。
can 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 can reduce。
表示「花錢在某事上」使用 spend money on something。
這裡泛指部分員工，所以使用 some employees。
employees 是複數，因此使用 feel。
design 是第三身單數，因此使用 does not。
may 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 may make。
they 是複數主語，因此使用 have。
should 後面使用動詞原形，所以是 should provide。
should 同時控制 provide 和 allow，兩個動詞都要使用原形。
without 是介詞，後面的動作通常使用動名詞，所以是 without causing。
表示「前往日本是為了參觀城市」，通常使用 to + 動詞原形 表達目的，所以寫 to visit。
near 可以直接接地方，所以寫 near the railway station。也可以寫 close to the railway station。
convenience 是名詞；這裡放在 was very 後面，需要形容詞 convenient。
information 在一般英文中是不可數名詞，不能寫 informations。可以寫 much information、a lot of information 或 several pieces of information。
這是放在 asked 後面的間接問句，使用陳述句語序：where + 主語 + 動詞。
suggest 通常使用 suggest that + 主語 + 動詞，或者 suggest + verb-ing。不要直接寫 suggest someone to do。
寺廟是「被建造」，所以需要被動語態 was built。
描述正在下雨時，最自然的主語通常是形式主語 it：It was raining.
heavily 修飾下雨的程度，通常放在 raining 後面：raining heavily。
前面使用 If + had + 過去分詞，結果部分通常使用 would have + 過去分詞。
many 後面接可數名詞複數，所以寫 many memories。
整段描述去年的旅程；gave 和 broadened 是兩個並列的過去式動作。
「an」在此應改為「a」。community 以輔音音素/k/開始，前面用 a， 不用 an。 公式：a + 輔音音素開首的單數可數名詞。
「volunteers」在此應改為「volunteer」。each 後面接單數可數名詞，所以寫 each volunteer，不用 volunteers。
「arriving」在此應改為「to arrive」。ask + 人後面用 to + 動詞原形，所以寫 asked us to arrive。
「helping」在此應改為「help」。to 不定詞後面用動詞原形，所以寫 to help， 不是 to helping。
「that was」在此應改為「that were」。關係分句的主語是複數 books， 所以 be 的過去式用 were。
「on」在此應改為「in」。interested 的固定搭配是 interested in + 名詞／動名詞，所以寫 interested in space。
「to work」在此應改為「working」。enjoy 後面接動名詞，所以寫 enjoyed working， 不寫 enjoyed to work。
「confidence」在此應改為「confident」。make + 人／物 + 形容詞。 me 後面要用形容詞 confident，不用名詞 confidence。
「were」在此應改為「was」。fridge 單數主語，be 的過去式用 was，所以寫 our fridge was。
「many information」在此應改為「much information」。information 是不可數名詞，不能用 many；這裡可寫 much information。
「allowed customers compare」在此應改為「allowed customers to compare」。allow + 人 + to + 動詞原形，所以寫 allowed customers to compare。
「where could we buy」在此應改為「where we could buy」。asked 後面是間接問句，要用陳述句語序： where + 主語 + 情態動詞。
「ordering」在此應改為「to order」。decide 後面通常接 to 不定詞，所以寫 decided to order。
「that located」在此應改為「that was located」。supermarket 是「位於」某處，完整被動關係分句要有 be + 過去分詞： that was located。
「could to deliver」在此應改為「could deliver」。could 後面直接用動詞原形，不用 to，所以寫 could deliver。
「bottle」在此應改為「bottles」。two 後面接複數可數名詞，所以寫 two bottles。
「was」在此應改為「were」。完整主語是 two bottles of milk，中心詞 bottles 是複數，所以用 were。
「contacted with」在此應改為「contacted」。contact 作動詞時直接接對象，所以寫 contacted support， 不加 with。
「discussed about」在此應改為「discussed」。discuss 作動詞時直接接討論內容，所以寫 discussed the problem，不加 about。
「refund」在此應改為「refunded」。apologised、sent 和 refunded 是三個並列的過去式動作，所以 refund 要改為 refunded。
「are」在此應改為「is」。真正的主語中心詞是單數 list；of places 只是修飾語，所以寫 The list… is。
「include」在此應改為「includes」。neither route 按單數主語處理，所以一般現在式動詞用 includes。
「must to bring」在此應改為「must bring」。must 後面直接用動詞原形，不加 to，所以寫 must bring。
「members」在此應改為「member」。each 後面接單數可數名詞，所以寫 each member。
「arrive」在此應改為「to arrive」。ask + 人後面用 to + 動詞原形，所以寫 asked each member to arrive。
「less」在此應改為「fewer」。buses 是可數名詞複數，表示數量較少用 fewer， 不用 less。
「it will rain」在此應改為「it rains」。第一條件句的 if 分句通常用一般現在式，所以寫 if it rains； will 放在結果分句。
「that located」在此應改為「that is located」。museum 是「位於」附近，所以關係分句要有 is located。
「are」在此應改為「is」。equipment 是不可數名詞，按單數處理，所以寫 The equipment is。
「Despite of receiving」在此應改為「Despite receiving」。despite 本身已經是介詞，後面直接接名詞或動名詞，不加 of。 公式： despite + 名詞／動名詞。正確對照：in spite of receiving，因為 in spite 後面需要 of。

issues.wrongText: one of the most useful project
issues.replacementText: one of the most useful projects
issues.explanationZhHant: 「one of the most useful project」在此應改為「one of the most useful projects」。one of 表示「一群之中的一個」，所以 of 後面的可數名詞用複數。公式：one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞。正確對照： This is the most useful project.
「since six months」在此應改為「for six months」。six months 是一段時間，要用 for。since 後面通常接起點。公式：for + 時段； since + 起點。正確：for six months／ since March。
「used to offering」在此應改為「used to offer」。used to 表示過去的習慣或狀態，後面用動詞原形。公式：used to + 動詞原形。邊界：be used to + 名詞／動名詞，例如 She is used to working late。
「look forward to learn」在此應改為「look forward to learning」。look forward to 裡面的 to 是介詞，所以後面的動作用動名詞。公式： look forward to + 名詞／動名詞。正確對照： hope to learn，因為 hope 後面的 to 是不定詞標記。
「managed fixing」在此應改為「managed to fix」。這裡 manage 表示「成功做到」，後面接 to 不定詞。公式： manage to + 動詞原形。邊界： manage a repair team 中， manage 可直接接名詞，意思是「管理」。
「prevented several batteries ending」在此應改為「prevented several batteries from ending」。prevent 後面先寫受影響的人或物，再用 from + 動名詞表示被阻止的動作。公式： prevent + 人／物 + from + 動名詞。邊界： prevent an accident 可直接接名詞。

issues.wrongText: explained new visitors the safety rules
issues.replacementText: explained the safety rules to new visitors
issues.explanationZhHant: 「explained new visitors the safety rules」在此應改為「explained the safety rules to new visitors」。explain 先接所解釋的內容，再用 to 接聽者。公式： explain + 事情 + to + 人。正確替代： The coordinator told the visitors the safety rules，因為 tell 可使用雙賓語。

issues.wrongText: provided every team by the necessary gloves
issues.replacementText: provided every team with the necessary gloves
issues.explanationZhHant: 「provided every team by the necessary gloves」在此應改為「provided every team with the necessary gloves」。表示「為某人提供某物」可用 provide + 人 + with + 物。這裡不能用 by。另一個正確寫法是 provide the necessary gloves for every team。
「reminded to write」在此應改為「reminded them to write」。remind 通常要指出提醒的對象。這裡 them 指上一句的 new visitors。 公式： remind + 人 + to + 動詞原形。邊界： remember to write 表示主語自己記得做某事。
「let children to test」在此應改為「let children test」。let 後面接人，再直接用動詞原形，不加 to。 公式：let + 人 + 動詞原形。正確對照：allow children to test， 因為 allow 需要 to 不定詞。
「made everyone to wear」在此應改為「made everyone wear」。主動句中的使役動詞 make 使用 make + 人 + 動詞原形，不加 to。邊界：被動句要恢復 to，例如 Everyone was made to wear eye protection。
